text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Scored year, day-ahead forecasts of the five decision substations on the nights (22:00 to 08:00 UTC) that follow a cold-snap day (a UTC-day mean ERA5 temperature under 2 C), rows outside hand-filtered events. Lines: the median over those nights at each half-hour. A5 is not drawn: its day-ahead run covers one origin in three days, so it has too few cold nights; A4 stands in, and A5 equals A4 where no flow is found.'
text.tspan: Scored year, day-ahead forecasts of the five decision substations on the nights (22:00 to 08:00
UTC) that follow a cold-snap day (a UTC-day mean ERA5 temperature under 2 C), rows outside
hand-filtered events. Lines: the median over those nights at each half-hour. A5 is not drawn:
its day-ahead run covers one origin in three days, so it has too few cold nights; A4 stands in,
and A5 equals A4 where no flow is found.
